subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: Should maintainers accept `device-enterprise`, `COPILOT_GITHUB_DOMAIN`, `models.providers.github-copilot.params.githubDomain`, domain-scoped Copilot token caching, and one SDK host-normalizer export as the supported bundled-provider fix for GHE.com data-residency Copilot users?
rationale: The code and live proof support the fix, but it changes auth routing, persisted provider params, an environment override, SDK surface, and token-host boundaries that require owner/security intent rather than an automated cleanup decision.

options.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
options.body: Keep the current fail-closed design, dismiss stale fixed reviews, refresh the merge, and land once exact-head checks remain green.

options.title: Narrow the exposed surface further
options.body: Ask for more auth/config/SDK surface to be internalized if maintainers want tenant routing but not this public shape.

options.title: Pause or reject bundled tenant routing
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged or close it if maintainers decide GHE.com Copilot support should be external or redesigned.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
recommendation.body: Keep the current fail-closed design, dismiss stale fixed reviews, refresh the merge, and land once exact-head checks remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion cites this handle's owner guidance on the existing-provider direction, and history connects the handle to the provider/docs area.
